text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I'm still wide awake. At this rate, I'm
certain to
end up sleep-deprived
tomorrow.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(There's but one recourse. I must focus
my mind by mentally drilling my
techniques and clearing my head of
unnecessary thoughts. Restful sleep will
soon be mine!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I'll practice my strikes to start.
Release the
tension in my body, lower my center
of gravity, then strike by letting the
weight of my arm deliver the blow!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What just happened?! Did I perform that strike? It was over in the blink of an eye—no, it was faster than a flash of light!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I may be on the verge of a breakthrough.
This
feeling, this state of mind—I must
master it
completely!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki ends up staying awake all
night
long.
